name: Zentech Manufacturing, Inc.

about:
Zentech Manufacturing, Inc. was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in Baltimore, Maryland, with additional facilities in Richardson, Texas, and Bloomington, Illinois. The company operates as an electronic manufacturing services (EMS) provider specializing in high-reliability, high-complexity assemblies for mission-critical applications.

The company delivers full-turnkey electronic manufacturing services, including printed circuit board assembly (PCBA), system-level assembly and integration, comprehensive inspection and testing, higher-level assembly (HLA), new product introduction (NPI), program management, test development, and supply chain services. Zentech operates 180,000 square feet of manufacturing space across three sites, equipped with 11 surface-mount technology (SMT) lines, and focuses on low-to-medium volume, high-mix production of complex, high-reliability assemblies compliant with IPC 610 Class 2 and Class 3 standards.

Zentech serves primarily the defense and aerospace sector, which accounts for approximately 85 percent of its business, along with medical device manufacturers (10 percent) and commercial/industrial clients (5 percent). Its assemblies are used in mission-critical applications that protect national infrastructure and warfighters, though specific customer names are not disclosed.

Zentech emphasizes its comprehensive certification portfolio—including AS9100, ISO 13485, ITAR registration, IPC 610 Trusted Source Supplier, IPC J-STD-001 Space Addendum, and IPC 1791 Trusted Assembler—as a key differentiator for high-reliability medical and military circuit card assemblies. The company also highlights its in-house engineering team, including electro-mechanical designers, electrical design engineers, and test engineers, as a distinction from typical contract manufacturers.
